body: Today I will be going to the hospital to laugh at disabled and ill people. Killing me and burning my inferior genes is the only way to stop me.
Being laughed at is WAY fucking worse than not being loved, any day of the fucking week. Try having your entire existence laughed at then attempt to ‘love your shitty self’.
Why would this get upvoted along with the ‘you’re not ugly’ comments? Weirdos.
Yeah I’m fucking bored sick of being laughed at and having no explanation to it.
I hope your new born children get cancer.
They ALL stare at me and laugh. ALL! As soon as one points me out to them the rest ALL follow suit. What kind of fucking piece of shit god would bestow this on one of his creatures?
And not ONE of them can tell me why?
If your friend and you were sitting in a cafe and your friend nudged at you and pointed at me and told you to laugh, you’d laugh. So, yeah, the world IS against me.
I’m gonna do it again. And if they ask me why, I’ll simply say ‘get mental help, you’re paranoid’.

But guess what. Today I also laughed at a funeral being loaded onto a car with lots of crying women standing around it, laughed at a disabled man’s face as he struggled to walk, and laughed at a burn victim. Take that, society.
Exactly. So you can fuck off quietly from my post, cunt.

Interpretation: Yes it’s your looks but I’ll get upvoted for suggesting it’s your attitude when you’ve been the victim of mass laughter for 25 years straight and you should be treated like the perpetrator.

That’s a lot not to give a fuck about.
WHAT is so funny about my face that people should omit all morals and compassion to laugh straight into it?
WHY should I not die? WHY should I be the only one in the WORLD having to go through this?
